# Andrej Kirbiš — 社会学研究

马里博尔大学社会学正教授。研究领域包括政治参与、两极分化、健康社会学、疫苗犹豫、健康素养、青年研究、环境态度、人与动物关系、志愿服务和比较调查研究。

作品标题、作者、期刊名称和 DOI 标识符均保留原文。说明文字的翻译不表示相关作品存在翻译版本。

## 出版物与研究数据，2008–2026年

- 2026. Psychometric properties of the European health literacy survey questionnaire short-short form (HLS-EU-Q6) among Slovenian youth, adults, and older adults. https://doi.org/10.1186/s12889-026-28926-5 — 在斯洛文尼亚样本中（N=3,360），HLS-EU-Q6 在各年龄组均显示出令人满意的信度，但其单因子结构在老年人群中的拟合优于青年和成年人；四个条目存在随年龄而变化的功能差异。
- 2026. Environmental issue polarization across democracies: Political orientation, environmental attitudes, and private-sphere pro-environmental behaviour. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jenvp.2026.103240 — 基于 ISSP Environment IV（2020–2022年）数据，右翼政治取向与较少的私人领域亲环境行为相关，环境态度发挥了部分中介作用；在自由民主程度较高的国家，直接和间接关联均更强。
- 2026. Extending the civic voluntarism model: A cross-national study of environmental public sphere behavior. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.heliyon.2025.e44242 — 在 28 个国家（2020 ISSP，N=44,100）中，公民志愿模型最好地解释了政府质量高的富裕国家的环境公共领域行为。
- 2026. From political news consumption to political participation: The mediating role of ideological polarization across 24 countries. https://doi.org/10.1080/00207659.2026.2667737 — 在 24 个欧洲国家（ESS 第 11 轮）中，意识形态极化对政治新闻消费和参与之间的联系的中介作用不一致，只有五到六个国家产生了积极的间接影响。
- 2026. Evaluating the psychometric properties of the 7C vaccination readiness scale: Evidence from Slovenia. https://doi.org/10.2478/sjph-2026-0004 — 在斯洛文尼亚（N=1,350），一般疫苗接种准备因素是疫苗接种意愿最强的预测因素，7C 量表比 5C 量表解释了更多的意愿差异。
- 2026. Are individuals with persistently high conspiracy mentality also persistently vaccine-hesitant? Findings from a three-wave panel study. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.socscimed.2025.118770 — 在斯洛文尼亚三轮追踪调查中（N=574），阴谋心态与疫苗犹豫是稳定且相关的倾向，在四个月内未发现二者相互导致的关系；较低的科学信任将二者联系起来。
- 2026. Perceived ideological polarization, trust in science and healthcare, and COVID-19 vaccination intention: A four-wave cross-lagged mediation panel analysis. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.socscimed.2026.119057 — 在斯洛文尼亚四轮追踪调查中（N=488），随机截距交叉滞后模型未发现感知意识形态极化对后续信任或接种意愿存在个体内因果效应；个体间科学信任和医疗信任的差异可预测COVID-19 疫苗接种意愿。
- 2026. The impact of affective polarization on political participation: A systematic review. https://doi.org/10.1177/00323217251338496 — 一项纳入18项研究的系统综述发现，情感极化大多与政治参与呈正相关，且与制度性参与的关联强于非制度性参与。
- 2026. . undefined
- 2026. . undefined
- 2025. Does health literacy mediate sociodemographic and economic inequalities in fruit and vegetable intake? An analysis of Slovenian national HLS19 survey data. https://doi.org/10.3390/foods14030378 — 使用斯洛文尼亚 HLS19 数据（N=3,360），健康素养部分中介了水果和蔬菜摄入的社会经济不平等。
- 2025. Education and meat consumption and reduction: The mediating role of climate literacy. https://doi.org/10.3390/foods14193333 — 在14-88岁的斯洛文尼亚人中（N=2,990），气候态度和气候素养中介了更高的受教育程度与较低肉类消费和减少肉类消费意愿之间的关系。
- 2025. Why does health literacy matter, and for whom? Explaining the differentiating impact of health literacy on vaccine attitudes. https://doi.org/10.3389/fpsyg.2025.1470654 — 在斯洛文尼亚（N = 3,360），健康素养直接或通过减少疫苗神话信念加强了疫苗态度，对接受过医疗保健培训的人影响更大。
- 2025. Seasonal influenza vaccination uptake among health and medical college students: A discrete choice experiment. https://doi.org/10.1080/21645515.2025.2530287 — 在斯洛文尼亚医学和健康学生（N=239）的离散选择实验中，更高的疫苗功效和更少的副作用是流感疫苗选择的最强驱动力。
- 2025. The impact of health on voting intent among youth in nine Southeast European countries: A mediation analysis on the role of political trust. https://doi.org/10.1080/14683857.2025.2576290 — 在九个东南欧国家中，政治信任提高了年轻人的投票意愿，并且仅在斯洛文尼亚中介了健康与投票的联系。
- 2025. Illicit drug use in adolescence: Associations with parenting styles, parental drug rules, and parental drug use [Uporaba prepovedanih drog v mladostništvu]. undefined
- 2025. Education for future? Investigating the role of education in explaining active green engagement: A multilevel moderated mediation analysis. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.sftr.2025.100608 — 在 28 个国家（ISSP，N=44,100）中，为环境保护付费的意愿在一定程度上中介了教育与绿色参与之间的联系，并且这一路径在低腐败国家更为明显。
- 2025. Measuring climate knowledge: A systematic review of quantitative studies. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isci.2025.111888 — 对92项研究的系统回顾发现，气候知识的测量不一致，特别是在其维度的定义方式上，需要标准化的测量工具。
- 2025. Cognitive and affective drivers of pro-environmental behaviour among youth and adults: Evidence from Slovenia, European, and non-European regions. In A. Kirbiš et al. (Eds.),. undefined
- 2025. Demographic and socioeconomic predictors of perceived ideological polarization in Slovenia. In A. Kirbiš et al. (Eds.),. undefined
- 2025. Social media use for political information, political efficacy, and political participation among youth in Montenegro and Slovenia. In A. Kirbiš et al. (Eds.),. undefined
- 2025. . undefined
- 2024. Multilevel analysis of COVID-19 vaccination intention: The moderating role of economic and cultural country characteristics. https://doi.org/10.1093/eurpub/ckae022 — 在 26 个欧洲国家（ESS 第 10 轮，N≈51,000）中，机构信任和医疗保健满意度在腐败程度较低、较发达国家更强烈地预测了 COVID-19 疫苗接种意愿，​​而阴谋论在腐败程度较高、集体主义国家中具有更强的负面影响。
- 2024. Predictors of meat reduction: The case of Slovenia. https://doi.org/10.3390/foods13152346 — 在斯洛文尼亚的一项调查中，年龄是减少肉类的意图和行为的唯一显着预测因素，中老年人比年轻人更有可能减少肉类。
- 2024. Ideological differences in COVID-19 vaccine intention: The effects of trust in the healthcare system, in complementary and alternative medicine, and perceived threat from the disease. https://doi.org/10.3389/fpsyg.2024.1332697 — 在斯洛文尼亚 (N=858)，左倾人士报告了较高的 COVID-19 疫苗接种意愿，​​原因是对医疗保健的更大信任和对补充药物的依赖较低。
- 2024. The validity and reliability of the Slovenian version of the health literacy questionnaire short-form (HLS-EU-Q16) among adults and older adults. https://doi.org/10.3389/fpubh.2024.1474539 — 斯洛文尼亚 HLS-EU-Q16 健康素养调查问卷在成年人 (N=2,327) 和老年人 (N=876) 中显示出足够的有效性和可靠性。
- 2024. Exploring the inherent heterogeneity of vaccine hesitancy: A study of a childhood-vaccine-hesitant population. https://doi.org/10.3390/vaccines12080839 — 对对疫苗犹豫不决的斯洛文尼亚人 (N=421) 进行的潜在剖面分析发现了三个亚组，其中最具抵抗力的特点是严重依赖个人研究、阴谋认可和医疗保健不信任。
- 2024. Understanding vaccine hesitancy: A comparison of sociodemographic and socioeconomic predictors with health literacy dimensions. https://doi.org/10.3390/vaccines12101141 — 在斯洛文尼亚（N=3,360），年龄较小、教育程度较低和经济贫困程度较高分别独立地预测了较高的疫苗犹豫度。
- 2024. The politicization of the COVID-19 pandemic. In N. Rezaei (Ed.),. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-031-61943-4_9
- 2024. "Yes to democracy, but this is not what we had in mind!": Satisfaction with democracy among post-Yugoslav youth in the 2008–2018 period. In M. Harring (Ed.),. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-031-58626-2_11
- 2024. Zdravstvena pismenost in cepljenje: vprašanja, izzivi in rešitve [Health literacy and vaccination: Questions, challenges and solutions]. In A. Kirbiš et al. (Eds.),. undefined
- 2024. Analiza zdravstvene pismenosti v Sloveniji: pregled raziskav [Analysis of health literacy in Slovenia: A review]. In A. Kirbiš et al. (Eds.),. undefined
- 2024. Zdravstvena pismenost in cepljenje: pregled raziskav in priporočila [Health literacy and vaccination: Research review and recommendations]. In A. Kirbiš et al. (Eds.),. undefined
- 2024. Kritična zdravstvena pismenost in cepljenje: pregled raziskav [Critical health literacy and vaccination: A review]. In A. Kirbiš et al. (Eds.),. undefined
- 2024. Kritična zdravstvena pismenost in omahovanje staršev glede otroških cepiv v Sloveniji [Critical health literacy and parental hesitancy regarding childhood vaccines in Slovenia]. In A. Kirbiš et al. (Eds.),. undefined
- 2024. . undefined
- 2023. Physical health conditions and political participation in Europe: The moderating effects of age. https://doi.org/10.1057/s41295-023-00347-3 — 根据欧洲社会调查数据，大多数身体健康问题促使人们参与政治，但投票参与除外；这一效应在年轻公民中最强。
- 2023. Prevajalce poučujemo jezik drugače, mar ne? [We teach translators language differently, don't we?]. https://doi.org/10.4312/ars.17.1.109-123
- 2023. The impact of socioeconomic status, perceived threat and healthism on vaccine hesitancy. https://doi.org/10.3390/su15076107 — 在斯洛文尼亚（N=661），对疫苗可预防疾病的较低感知威胁和对医疗保健的不信任是疫苗犹豫的最强预测因素，这与健康主义的解释一致。
- 2023. Environmental attitudes among youth: How much do the educational characteristics of parents and young people matter?. https://doi.org/10.3390/su151511921 — 在斯洛文尼亚青年（N=1,508）中，普通中学生比职业中学生持有更强的环保态度，而家长教育影响甚微。
- 2023. Depressive symptoms among Slovenian female tertiary students before and during the COVID-19 pandemic: Analysis of two repeated cross-sectional surveys in 2020 and 2021. https://doi.org/10.3390/su151813776 — 在斯洛文尼亚女大学生样本中（N=418），抑郁症状从2020年初到2021年显著增加；疫情期间报告多种抑郁情绪的几率接近原来的三倍。
- 2022. Cannabis use and parenting practices among young people: The impact of parenting styles, parental cannabis-specific rules, and parental cannabis use. https://doi.org/10.3390/ijerph19138080 — 在斯洛文尼亚青年（N=839）中，母亲的权威养育、严格的大麻具体规则和父母不使用大麻降低了大麻的使用，而父母使用大麻是使用大麻的最强预测因素。
- 2022. Distrustful, dissatisfied, and conspiratorial: A latent profile analysis of COVID-19 vaccination rejection. https://doi.org/10.3390/ijerph191610096 — 使用欧洲社会调查数据（N=1,252），不信任、不满和阴谋论的结合形成了最有可能拒绝接种疫苗的人群。
- 2022. The impact of cultural capital on vaccine attitudes among the Slovenian public. https://doi.org/10.3390/vaccines10111947 — 在斯洛文尼亚（N=661），参与高雅文化活动预示着更支持疫苗的态度，而正规教育则没有效果。
- 2022. Vaccine hesitancy around the world: The problem, prospects, and future directions. In R. Baikady (Ed.),. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-68127-2_152-1
- 2022. Oklevanje pred cepljenjem, zaupanje v zdravstveni sistem, percepcija nalezljivih bolezni in odločanje za cepljenje proti covidu-19: pojasnjevalna vloga zaupanja Nacionalnemu inštitutu za javno zdravje = General vaccine hesitancy, trust in the healthcare system, perception of infectious diseases and Covid-19 vaccination intention: the explanatory role of trust in the National Institute of Public Health. https://plus.cobiss.net/cobiss/si/sl/bib/130685443 — 疫苗犹豫、医疗保健信任、疾病认知和对国家公共卫生研究所的信任。
- 2021. Political orientation in youth beyond the left-right divide: Testing a three-factor model of political orientation and its relatedness to personal values. https://doi.org/10.1080/13676261.2021.1939285 — 在斯洛文尼亚青年（N=1,015）中，三维模型（社会、经济、国际）比传统的左右尺度更好地捕捉了政治取向。
- 2021. Učinek izobrazbe na poznavanje znanstvenih dejstev o cepljenju in na namero za cepljenje proti covidu-19 v Sloveniji [Effect of education on knowledge of scientific facts about vaccination and intention to vaccinate against COVID-19 in Slovenia]. undefined
- 2021. The role of education in sustainable dietary patterns in Slovenia. https://doi.org/10.3390/su132313036 — 在斯洛文尼亚全国样本（N = 1,079）中，更高的受教育程度独立预测肉类消费量较低（但不是鱼或牛奶），揭示了可持续饮食的教育梯度。
- 2021. Kulturna participacija: konceptualizacija, dimenzionalnost in profili [Cultural participation: Conceptualization, dimensionality and profiles]. In A. Kirbiš et al. (Eds.),. undefined

Kulturni kapital, avtoritativni vzgojni stil in razvojni izidi mladih v meddržavni primerjalni perspektivi: analiza desetih držav Jugovzhodne Evrope [Cultural capital, authoritative parenting style, and developmental outcomes of youth in cross-national perspective: Analysis of ten Southeast European countries].
